facts.text: Marian University awards 75 San Damiano Scholarships with awards up to full tuition for students committed to church leadership who major or minor in Ministry Studies.

sources.title: San Damiano Scholars Program | Marian University
sources.quote: Marian University awards 75 San Damiano Scholars, with awards ranging up to full tuition, to students who are committed to becoming transformational leaders in the Church.
